name: enable_auto_scaling
description: Enable node pool autoscaling

name: agents_pool_name
description: The default Azure AKS agentpool (nodepool) name.

name: net_profile_docker_bridge_cidr
description: (Optional) IP address (in CIDR notation) used as the Docker bridge IP address on nodes. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: agents_labels
description: (Optional) A map of Kubernetes labels which should be applied to nodes in the Default Node Pool. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: orchestrator_version
description: Specify which Kubernetes release to use for the orchestration layer. The default used is the latest Kubernetes version available in the region

name: client_id
description: (Optional) The Client ID (appId) for the Service Principal used for the AKS deployment

name: client_secret
description: (Optional) The Client Secret (password) for the Service Principal used for the AKS deployment

name: log_analytics_workspace_sku
description: The SKU (pricing level) of the Log Analytics workspace. For new subscriptions the SKU should be set to PerGB2018

name: enable_azure_policy
description: Enable Azure Policy Addon.

name: sku_tier
description: The SKU Tier that should be used for this Kubernetes Cluster. Possible values are Free and Paid

name: rbac_aad_client_app_id
description: The Client ID of an Azure Active Directory Application.

name: network_policy
description: (Optional) Sets up network policy to be used with Azure CNI. Network policy allows us to control the traffic flow between pods. Currently supported values are calico and azure. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: agents_availability_zones
description: (Optional) A list of Availability Zones across which the Node Pool should be spread. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: agents_count
description: The number of Agents that should exist in the Agent Pool. Please set `agents_count` `null` while `enable_auto_scaling` is `true` to avoid possible `agents_count` changes.

name: enable_kube_dashboard
description: Enable Kubernetes Dashboard.

name: enable_role_based_access_control
description: Enable Role Based Access Control.

name: rbac_aad_server_app_id
description: The Server ID of an Azure Active Directory Application.

name: network_plugin
description: Network plugin to use for networking.

name: net_profile_service_cidr
description: (Optional) The Network Range used by the Kubernetes service. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: agents_min_count
description: Minimum number of nodes in a pool

name: agents_max_pods
description: (Optional) The maximum number of pods that can run on each agent. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: admin_username
description: The username of the local administrator to be created on the Kubernetes cluster

name: public_ssh_key
description: A custom ssh key to control access to the AKS cluster

name: tags
description: Any tags that should be present on the Virtual Network resources

name: os_disk_size_gb
description: Disk size of nodes in GBs.

name: net_profile_dns_service_ip
description: (Optional) IP address within the Kubernetes service address range that will be used by cluster service discovery (kube-dns). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: net_profile_pod_cidr
description: (Optional) The CIDR to use for pod IP addresses. This field can only be set when network_plugin is set to kubenet. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: enable_node_public_ip
description: (Optional) Should nodes in this Node Pool have a Public IP Address? Defaults to false.

name: kubernetes_version
description: Specify which Kubernetes release to use. The default used is the latest Kubernetes version available in the region

name: resource_group_name
description: The resource group name to be imported

name: prefix
description: The prefix for the resources created in the specified Azure Resource Group

name: agents_size
description: The default virtual machine size for the Kubernetes agents

name: log_retention_in_days
description: The retention period for the logs in days

name: vnet_subnet_id
description: (Optional) The ID of a Subnet where the Kubernetes Node Pool should exist. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: rbac_aad_admin_group_object_ids
description: Object ID of groups with admin access.

name: net_profile_outbound_type
description: (Optional) The outbound (egress) routing method which should be used for this Kubernetes Cluster. Possible values are loadBalancer and userDefinedRouting. Defaults to loadBalancer.

name: enable_log_analytics_workspace
description: Enable the creation of azurerm_log_analytics_workspace and azurerm_log_analytics_solution or not

name: private_cluster_enabled
description: If true cluster API server will be exposed only on internal IP address and available only in cluster vnet.

name: enable_http_application_routing
description: Enable HTTP Application Routing Addon (forces recreation).

name: rbac_aad_server_app_secret
description: The Server Secret of an Azure Active Directory Application.

name: agents_type
description: (Optional) The type of Node Pool which should be created. Possible values are AvailabilitySet and VirtualMachineScaleSets. Defaults to VirtualMachineScaleSets.

name: rbac_aad_managed
description: Is the Azure Active Directory integration Managed, meaning that Azure will create/manage the Service Principal used for integration.

name: agents_max_count
description: Maximum number of nodes in a pool

name: agents_tags
description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the Node Pool.
